_readme: The source of truth for what a sectors.app feature does. A feature reel is composed FROM an entry
here, never from memory: the claims on screen and the claims in the voiceover both trace back to a
line in this file, so two reels shipped a month apart describe the same feature the same way.
If the feature you have been asked to promote is not in here, do not invent an entry. Ask for the
promise, the proof and the destination, write the entry, and compose from it. That way the next reel
about that feature starts from something checked rather than from this conversation's guesswork.
name      what the product calls it on screen, exactly. Not a friendlier synonym.
promise   one line, what it does for the viewer. The `feature` scene renders this verbatim.
chips     up to 3 capability tags, 1-4 words each. Nouns and figures, never sentences.
proof     the single strongest concrete fact. Becomes a cover stat or the demo's body line.
who       who this is for, in the team's own words. Steers the hook, never rendered.
demo      the footage: kind (clip|shot), src, and the device frame it belongs in.
cta       the path a viewer types. Real and specific, never the bare homepage for a named feature.
verified  what the entry is grounded in, and when. An unverified claim is a claim you must confirm
with the user before it reaches a rendered frame.
Put recordings in inputs/demo/ and stills in inputs/shots/. render.mjs resolves a relative src
against the storyboard file first, then against the skill root.

financial-search.name: Financial Search Engine
financial-search.promise: Ask for a company, a sector or an investor in plain English. Get the figure, not a list of links.
financial-search.proof: Purpose-built for professionals and enterprise research teams, with natural language query support.
financial-search.who: Analysts who currently open six tabs to answer one question.
financial-search.verified: Wording taken from the product surface in assets/brand/app-overview.png (search panel, Agentic Search on Standard+). Confirm the plan gating before quoting it in a new reel. Superseded by the ai-search-console entry below (per product team, 2026-07-24).

ai-search-console.name: AI Search Console
ai-search-console.promise: Ask in plain English. Get the answer, the ownership, and the receipts.
ai-search-console.proof: Every AI answer surfaces its own API query and a one-click CSV download, so the number is checkable, not just quoted.
ai-search-console.who: Analysts and portfolio teams who need a checkable answer, not just a chat reply.
ai-search-console.verified: Captured from a screen recording provided by the user (AI console.mp4, 2026-07-24) showing unified ticker/sector/investor search with keyboard navigation, watchlist, ownership drill-down, related news, and an AI natural-language query with year filter, CSV export, and visible API query path. Per product team (2026-07-24), this is the developed successor to financial-search. Promise/chip wording synthesized from the recording; confirm with product owner before reuse in a future reel.

ownership-search.name: Ownership Search
ownership-search.promise: Follow a stake from the listed company up to whoever actually controls it.
ownership-search.who: Anyone who has tried to work out who is behind an IDX name from the filings alone.
ownership-search.verified: Surface confirmed in assets/brand/app-overview.png (Ownership Search toggle). The promise line is a description of the feature's purpose and needs a product owner's sign-off before it ships.

one-percent-search-engine.name: The 1% Search Engine
one-percent-search-engine.promise: Search any name, a person or a company, and see every IDX company where they hold a stake down to 1%.
one-percent-search-engine.proof: 7,190 Indonesia public company ownership records, sourced from IDX and KSEI, updated monthly.
one-percent-search-engine.who: Anyone tracing who actually stands behind an IDX company's shareholder list.
one-percent-search-engine.verified: Wording and figures taken from a user-supplied screenshot of the live page (2026-07-28): page header states '7,190 Indonesia Public Company ownership records in compliance with Liquidity Thresholds under MSCI Market Classification Framework. Data sourced from IDX and KSEI, updated monthly.' Tab is labeled 'The 1% Search Engine', subtitle 'Beneficial ownership transparency'. Demo search for 'dr lo kheng ho' returned 13 companies with per-company shareholder breakdown (type, country, holdings, ownership%).

watchlist.name: Watchlist
watchlist.promise: Keep the names you actually follow in one place, priced and updated without you asking.
watchlist.who: Retail investors following a handful of IDX names across several brokers.
watchlist.verified: Surface confirmed in assets/brand/app-overview.png (Watchlist tab) and the sibling sectors-newsletter-dbquery skill, which reads watchlist tracking per user. No footage captured yet.
